THE DETAILS, SIMPLIFIED

GOOD
QUESTIONS.

Still have something on your mind?

Ask Abdullah on WhatsApp
I'm a beginner. Can I start here?+

Yes. Share your experience and starting point with Abdullah so your plan can match your current ability, equipment and schedule.

Do I need to go to a gym?+

Your available equipment is part of the planning conversation. Tell Abdullah whether you train at home or at a gym, so you can agree on a suitable approach before enrolling.

How does online coaching work?+

You begin with a conversation about your goals and routine, then receive a personalized training approach and nutrition guidance. You stay in contact to review progress and discuss adjustments.

Will I have to give up my usual food?+

The aim is a practical routine you can follow. Discuss your usual meals, preferences and daily schedule during onboarding so nutrition guidance fits your life.

How soon will I see results?+

Progress varies with your starting point, consistency, recovery and individual circumstances. Discuss realistic goals with Abdullah; no specific amount of weight loss or timeline is guaranteed.

How do I pay and confirm my place?+

First confirm your plan, availability and terms with Abdullah on WhatsApp. Then send the agreed amount to the Vodafone Cash wallet 01003951645 and share your receipt privately in the same chat. Your place is confirmed by Abdullah after checking the payment.

Can I change or cancel my plan?+

Discuss plan changes, pauses, cancellations and any refund terms with Abdullah before making a payment. The website does not process subscriptions or issue refunds automatically.

 YOUR INFORMATION

This website does not have an account system, analytics tracking or a database for enquiry forms. Your entries remain in the page until you choose to open WhatsApp.
